## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature or improvement is.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Why is this feature needed or how would it improve the bot / dashboard?

## Proposed Solution / Implementation Idea
Describe how you imagine this feature working or being implemented.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or code snippets about the feature request here.
